paite: Saul in leng asih hoih asa hi. Huai ni in Jerusalem a saptuam omte tung ah nakpitak in sawina atung a; sawltakte kia lou ngal Judia leh Samaria bial teng ah adalhzak vekta uhi.
heading: Saptuamte Sawina Leh Dalhzakna
english: Saul was consenting to his death. A great persecution arose against the assembly which was in Jerusalem in that day. They were all scattered abroad throughout the regions of Judea and Samaria, except for the apostles.

paite: Huan Pathian limsak kuate hiam in Stephen avui ua, nakpitak in asuun uhi.
english: Devout men buried Stephen and lamented greatly over him.

paite: Saul in bel saptuam pawlte asawi a, inn teng a lut in, numei pasal akaikhia a, suangkul ah akhum hi.
english: But Saul ravaged the assembly, entering into every house and dragged both men and women off to prison.

paite: Huan adalhzakte kho teng ah apaita ua, thu agen zel uhi.
heading: Samaria Ah Philip
english: Therefore those who were scattered abroad went around preaching the word.

paite: Samaria ah Philip ahohsuk a, akiang uah Khrist thu atangkoupih hi.
english: Philip went down to the city of Samaria and proclaimed to them the Christ.

paite: Huan athillamdang hihte azak ua, amuh un, mipite'n lungsim mun khat in, Philip thugente alimsakta uhi.
english: The multitudes listened with one accord to the things that were spoken by Philip when they heard and saw the signs which he did.

paite: Dawi nin paimi tampi amatte uh sung a kipan in aw ngaihtak a kikou a pawt leh mizaw leh khebai tampi hihdam a a-om ziak un.
english: For unclean spirits came out of many of those who had them. They came out, crying with a loud voice. Many who had been paralyzed and lame were healed.

paite: Huchi in huai khopi ah nakpitak a kipahna a-om hi.
english: There was great joy in that city.

paite: Huan mi khat amin Simon a-om a; ama'n mithupi ka hi, chi in tuma lam in huai khua ah mitkhialdawi in Samaria khomite lamdang satak in abawl nilouh hi.
heading: Simon Mitkhialdawi
english: But there was a certain man, Simon by name, who used to practice sorcery in the city and amazed the people of Samaria, making himself out to be some great one,

paite: Mi tengteng, aneupen a pan alianpen tan in, "Hiai mi Pathian thilhihtheihna thupi achih uh ahi," chi in athu alimsak chiat uhi.
english: to whom they all listened, from the least to the greatest, saying, “This man is that great power of God.”

paite: Amitkhialdawi in sawtpi lamdang satak a abawl nak ziak in athu alimsak uhi.
english: They listened to him because for a long time he had amazed them with his sorceries.

paite: Himahleh Philip in Pathian lalgam tanchinhoih leh Jesu Khrist min agen pen agintak tak un, numei leh pasalte'n baptisma atangta uhi.
english: But when they believed Philip preaching good news concerning God’s Kingdom and the name of Jesus Christ, they were baptized, both men and women.

paite: Huan Simon nangawn in leng agingta a, baptisma atan zoh in Philip kiang ah a-om gige a, chiamtehna leh thillamdang thupite amu a, lamdang asa thei mahmah hi.
english: Simon himself also believed. Being baptized, he continued with Philip. Seeing signs and great miracles occurring, he was amazed.

paite: Huan sawltak Jerusalem a omte'n Samaria mite'n Pathian thu agingtata uh chih azak un, akiang uah Peter leh Johan asawl uhi.
heading: Samaria Gam A Peter Leh Johan Zinna
english: Now when the apostles who were at Jerusalem heard that Samaria had received the word of God, they sent Peter and John to them,

paite: Huai mite ava tunsuk uleh Kha Siangthou atantheihna ding un athumsak uhi.
english: who, when they had come down, prayed for them, that they might receive the Holy Spirit;

paite: Huai ma in alak uah kuamah tung ah atung nai kei a; Toupa Jesu min in baptisma atang phet uhi.
english: for as yet he had fallen on none of them. They had only been baptized in the name of Christ Jesus.

paite: Huan sawltakte'n atung uah akhut uh akoih ua, Kha Siangthou atangta uhi.
english: Then they laid their hands on them, and they received the Holy Spirit.

paite: Huan sawltakte khut ngakna ziak a Kha Siangthou piak ahi chih Simon in amuh in; dangka piak asawm hi.
english: Now when Simon saw that the Holy Spirit was given through the laying on of the apostles’ hands, he offered them money,

paite: "Hichibang thuneihna hon pe sam un, kuapeuh tung a leng khut ka koihna in Kha Siangthou atan samna ding in,” achi hi.
english: saying, “Give me also this power, that whomever I lay my hands on may receive the Holy Spirit.”

paite: Himahleh Peter in akiang ah, "Na dangka nang toh mangkhawm hen, Pathian thilpiak dangka sum a lei na tup ziak in.
english: But Peter said to him, “May your silver perish with you, because you thought you could obtain the gift of God with money!

paite: Hiai thu ah nang zaw na pang kei, tan leng na nei kei hi; Pathian ngaih in na lungtang adik kei hi.
english: You have neither part nor lot in this matter, for your heart isn’t right before God.

paite: Huaiziak in hiai na gitlouhna tawpsan inla, Toupa kiang ah thum in, huchi in na lungtang a na ngaihtuah ahon ngaidam khamoh ding hiam.
english: Repent therefore of this, your wickedness, and ask God if perhaps the thought of your heart may be forgiven you.

paite: Thil khakna sinkha ah leh gitlouh gaklopna ah na om chih ka thei hi," achi hi.
english: For I see that you are in the poison of bitterness and in the bondage of iniquity.”

paite: Huan Simon in, "Na thil gen uh bangmah ka tung a hong tunlouhna ding in noumau in Toupa kiang ah hon thumsak un," chi in adawng hi.
english: Simon answered, “Pray for me to the Lord, that none of the things which you have spoken happen to me.”

paite: Huchi in amau Toupa thu atheihsak ua, agen zoh nung un, Jerusalem a kik nawn in, Samari mite tenna khua tampi ah tanchinhoih agen zel uhi.
english: They therefore, when they had testified and spoken the word of the Lord, returned to Jerusalem, and preached the Good News to many villages of the Samaritans.

paite: Huan Toupa angel khat in Philip ahoupih a, "Thou inla, simlam a Jerusalem a kipan Gaza kho sunsuk lampi huai gamdai ah hoh in," achi hi.
heading: Philip Leh Ethiopia Michilgeh
english: Then an angel of the Lord spoke to Philip, saying, “Arise, and go toward the south to the way that goes down from Jerusalem to Gaza. This is a desert.”

paite: Huchi in athou a, apaita hi; huan ngai in, Ethiopia gam a mi khat, Ethiopia kumpinu Kandas gou tengteng kempa, michilgeh thuneitak, Jerusalem ah Pathian be ding in ahohtou hi.
english: He arose and went; and behold, there was a man of Ethiopia, a eunuch of great authority under Candace, queen of the Ethiopians, who was over all her treasure, who had come to Jerusalem to worship.

paite: Apaikik lam kangtalai a tu in zawlnei Isai laibu asim hi.
english: He was returning and sitting in his chariot, and was reading the prophet Isaiah.

paite: Huchi in Kha in Philip kiang ah, "Huai kangtalai va naih inla, va kithuahpih in,” achi hi.
english: The Spirit said to Philip, “Go near, and join yourself to this chariot.”

paite: Michilgeh kiang ah Philip ava tai a, zawlnei Isai laibu asim aza a, "Na laibu sim na theisiam hia?" achi hi.
english: Philip ran to him, and heard him reading Isaiah the prophet, and said, “Do you understand what you are reading?”

paite: Ama'n, “Kuamah hon hilhchet louh in bangchi in ka theisiam dia?" chi in akiang a kaltou a tutpih ding in Philip achialta hi.
english: He said, “How can I, unless someone explains it to me?” He begged Philip to come up and sit with him.

paite: Laisiangthou asim lai tuh hiai ahi: "Goh ding belam bang in amah api ua; belamnou amulmetpa ma a adaih dide bang in ama'n leng akam aka kei;
english: Now the passage of the Scripture which he was reading was this, “He was led as a sheep to the slaughter. As a lamb before his shearer is silent, so he doesn’t open his mouth.

paite: avuallelh lai in atung ah thugen aphal kei ua; asuante tanchin kua'n ahon gen ding ua? Khovel a kipan in ahinna alaksak ngal ua," chi in.
english: In his humiliation, his judgment was taken away. Who will declare His generation? For his life is taken from the earth.”

paite: Michilgeh in Philip ahoupih a akiang ah, "Zawlnei in hiai thu kua thu ahia agen, amah thu hia, midang thu? Ka hon dong hi," achi hi.
english: The eunuch answered Philip, “Who is the prophet talking about? About himself, or about someone else?”

paite: Huan Philip in adawng a, Laisiangthou thu abul a pan in, akiang ah Jesu thu ahilhta hi.
english: Philip opened his mouth, and beginning from this Scripture, preached to him about Jesus.

paite: Huan lampi a apai kawm un koi mun hiam tui omna khat atung ua; huan michilgeh in, "En dih, hiai ah tui a-om, baptisma ka tan ding bang in hon dal ahia?" achi hi.
english: As they went on the way, they came to some water; and the eunuch said, “Behold, here is water. What is keeping me from being baptized?”

paite: Philip in, "Na lungtang tengteng a na gintakleh na hi thei," achi hi. Ama'n, "Jesu Khrist, Pathian Tapa ahi chih ka gingta," chi in adawng hi.
Huchi in kangtalai akhawlsak ua, anih un, Philip leh michilgeh, tui ah ahohkhawmsuk ua; huchi in ama'n abaptista hi.
english: He commanded the chariot to stand still, and they both went down into the water, both Philip and the eunuch, and he baptized him.

paite: Huan tui a pan apaitouh un Toupa Kha in Philip alamangta a; huan michilgeh in amah amu nawnta kei, nuamsatak in apai zel hi.
english: When they came up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord caught Philip away, and the eunuch didn’t see him any more, for he went on his way rejoicing.

paite: Himahleh Azotas ah Philip muh in a-om nawn hi; huan apaisuak kawm in Kaisaria atun masiah kho teng ah tanchinhoih agen zel hi.
english: But Philip was found at Azotus. Passing through, he preached the Good News to all the cities until he came to Caesarea.
